inputs: All 12 pinned Lucide and Tabler originals; widths 64 and 256; transparent and #f2e4c8 backgrounds
reference: Chromium native SVG Image decoded into Canvas2D, independent of resvg; original SVG bytes
decoder: pngjs independently parses every PNG and validates PNG checksums
metrics: Mean absolute byte error across RGBA; fraction of pixels with any channel error > 32
checks: Exact dimensions and SHA-256; transparent inputs must contain alpha 0, alpha 255 and visible pixels; solid exports must have alpha 255 everywhere; originals byte-identical
visual: Retain side-by-side resvg/Chromium contact sheet and inspect for missing geometry, clipping, scaling, and color. Report disagreements even if aggregate tolerance passes.
scope: These icon collections exercise strokes and paths, not all SVG features. Labeled synthetic controls separately exercise viewport/clipping and rejection limits.
